avoid: Overextended deep knee drops without warm-up
Harsh boot slaps that sting the hands
children.counts: Simple 4-count and 8-count stepping and clapping blocks.
children.game_version: Play 'Captain's Kolenko': dancers form a line with hands on shoulders, and each child steps forward in turn to perform a funny or energetic kick for the others to mimic.

seniors.counts: Count in steady 8-count phrases without accelerating.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the slow opening arm sweeps and chest-level khlopushka claps from a sturdy chair; execute chechotka rhythms with gentle seated heel-and-toe taps.
seniors.standing_version: Hold onto a ballet barre or chair back with both hands; practice upright chechotka tap steps without dropping into floor squats.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Maintain a steady moderate tempo, omitting the rapid speed-up and limiting leg extensions to low ankle height.

feedback_rules.description: Hands must remain held behind the back during the stationary chechotka segment.
Movement phrases must resolve within the 8 to 16 bar musical square as the tempo accelerates.

learning_units.description: Slow entrance unit: execute broad hand and arm gestures, aligning into a shoulder-to-shoulder formation.
Stationary chechotka unit: execute fast rhythmic foot-tapping in place with hands held behind the back.
Acrobatic Russian steps: perform prisiadka (deep knee squats) and khlopushka (rhythmic body slaps).
Kolenko duel unit: alternate repeating a partner's movement and adding a new sequence within 8 to 16 bar phrases.

prerequisites.description: Lower-body strength and knee stability for repeated prisiadka squats.
Fast ankle articulation and rhythmic timing for chechotka tap work.

social_formats.description: Ensemble chorus line with hands resting on neighboring dancers' shoulders.
Call-and-response solo showcase where dancers alternate and duplicate kolenko movements.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Broad expressive entrance gestures, hands resting on shoulders in line formation, hands held behind the back during fixed-spot tapping, and khlopushka slapping against hands and legs
movement_profile.footwork: Rapid chechotka (tap dance) steps, percussive stomps, heel thrusts, and deep prisiadka squat extensions
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Linear chorus lines, stationary fixed-spot center stage, and circular call-and-response spaces
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Engaged core supporting explosive upward bounces out of floor squats and side-to-side torso sway
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Alternates between standing upright tap sequences and deep floor-level squat kicks
movement_profile.partnering: Non-partnered group unison or one-on-one call-and-response trick battles (kolenko)
movement_profile.posture: Upright spine, solid grounded center during standing tap; low compressed posture during squats

signature_moves.description: Deep knee bends and rapid squat kicks executed close to the floor
signature_moves.name: Prisiadka

signature_moves.description: Rapid percussive tap work danced in place with hands behind the back
signature_moves.name: Chechotka

signature_moves.description: Rhythmic percussive claps and slaps striking the boots, thighs, and hands
signature_moves.name: Khlopushka

signature_moves.description: A competitive solo variation or trick passed between dancers to challenge and replicate
signature_moves.name: Kolenko

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Starts composed and swaggering, shifting to an intense, driving, athletic acceleration
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid uncontrolled knee landings during prisiadka squats; keep the torso upright rather than collapsing forward when kicking

music_profile.musical_form: Structured musical square in 8 to 16 bar phrases with progressive tempo acceleration

reference_recordings.title: Russian Sailors Dance (from The Red Poppy)

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Driving square chastushka meter arranged in 8 to 16 bar sections
music_profile.sound_description: A punchy, minor-key chastushka melody driven by rhythmic button accordion or brass-heavy orchestral syncopation. Phrases cycle in rigid 8-to-16-measure squares that begin at a stately, swaggering tempo before steadily accelerating into a breakneck percussive sprint.
music_profile.tempo_bpm: Accelerates from slow to very fast
music_profile.vocal_style: Chastushka verse singing, often topical and satirical

basic_steps: Slow sailor entrance with broad sweeping arm gestures
Shoulder-to-shoulder formation with synchronized fast foot taps
Chechotka rapid percussive tap footwork performed on a fixed spot
Prisiadka deep knee bend squats and forward heel kicks
Khlopushka clapping and slapping combinations against thighs and boots
Kolenko trick exchange mirroring and answering a partner's movement
teaching.formation: Line formation with hands on shoulders, solo spotlight, or alternating duel circle
teaching.level_notes: Beginners focus on steady tempo acceleration and stationary tap footwork; advanced dancers execute floor-level prisiadka squats and acrobatic knee kicks
teaching.rhythm: Chastushka rhythm structured in 8 to 16 bar musical squares, accelerating from slow to very fast
